packet_semantics.state: Complete correlated TIMG tuple (value-held direct address or stable immutable material image/palette-set identity, format, exact size, width), actual Segment14 attachment identity, and E1 latch. No self-pointing span copies or independent field unions.
packet_semantics.control: PUSH returns all callee exits to caller continuation; NOPUSH replaces PC. E1 latches word1;04 validates both vertex-index*5/index*2 encodings and explores taken NOPUSH and untaken continuation. CULL records early-return state at the cull and also follows visible continuation. END returns state. Active cycles, unsupported address-bearing operations, malformed packets and finite-bound exhaustion reject rather than truncate.
packet_semantics.footprints: LOADBLOCK uses its load-unit count, full incoming size and source-origin prefix. LOADTILE retains source row-stride prefix through the last consumed texel. TLUT validates RGBA16 width1 and exact entry count. Every selected material image is bounded by the same witnessed tuple; no pool, whole-bank copy or NULL image-table scan.
packet_semantics.ownership: Reader borrows immutable canonical bytes and exact nonoverlapping initialized guest/ROM windows. Closure owns value vectors and no pimpl allocation. Scratch decode/state cache exists only during construction. World removes its former independent GBI walker and four duplicated metadata vectors in favor of optional value-owned Closure.
